verdict.rationale: CoreWeave's Terraform provider and CKS API allow managing many clusters, node pools, and resources declaratively (create/list/update/delete), which implicitly supports bulk infrastructure operations, and node pools/autoscaling let many nodes be provisioned/scaled together. However, there is no explicit documentation of a batch or bulk API endpoint (e.g., bulk create/delete across many items in one call) tailored for AI-native automation workflows. Missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch API endpoints, documented multi-resource batch operations, and independent verification of bulk automation use cases.
